events.title: Woodstock Festival anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Festival of Music & Art took place in Bethel, New York, in August 1969.

angles.name: Peace & Music
angles.copy: 57 years since half a million people descended on a dairy farm for three days of peace, love, and music. What's your ultimate Woodstock track?

events.title: Anniversary of Elvis Presley's passing
events.blurb: Elvis Presley, the 'King of Rock and Roll', passed away at his Graceland home on August 16, 1977, at the age of 42.

angles.name: Remembering The King
angles.copy: Remembering The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who passed away on this day in 1977. His music and legacy continue to inspire generations.

events.title: Anniversary of Tupac Shakur's passing
events.blurb: Influential American rapper Tupac Shakur was fatally shot in Las Vegas on September 7, 1996, and died six days later on September 13, 1996, at the age of 25.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the iconic Tupac Shakur, who passed away on this day. His powerful lyrics and impact on hip-hop culture remain undeniable.

events.title: Anniversary of Jimi Hendrix's passing
events.blurb: Legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix passed away in London on September 18, 1970, at the age of 27.

angles.name: Guitar Legend
angles.copy: Remembering Jimi Hendrix, one of the greatest guitarists of all time, who passed away on this day. His electrifying talent changed music forever.

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', in the UK on September 26, 1969.

angles.name: Iconic Album Cover
angles.copy: 57 years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That album cover is still one of the most famous in music history! What's your favourite track?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, the American-British singer, songwriter, and founding member of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday.

angles.name: Pretenders Frontwoman
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Her distinctive voice and fierce attitude as the frontwoman of The Pretenders have given us so many unforgettable tracks.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: William John Paul Gallagher, the English singer-songwriter and former frontman of Oasis and Beady Eye, celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Rock N Roll Star
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing the rock 'n' roll attitude and those iconic vocals. What's your favourite Liam track?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' album anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon released his critically acclaimed second solo studio album, 'Imagine', on September 9, 1971, in the US and October 8, 1971, in the UK.

angles.name: Imagine The Message
angles.copy: 55 years since John Lennon released the timeless album 'Imagine'. A powerful message of peace that still resonates today. What does the song mean to you?

events.title: First iPod released
events.blurb: Apple released the first-generation iPod, a portable digital music player, on October 23, 2001.

angles.name: Revolutionary Device
angles.copy: Remember when the first iPod dropped 25 years ago? It completely changed how we listen to music. How many songs did you cram onto yours?

events.title: Global James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day celebrates the release of the first James Bond film, 'Dr. No', which premiered on October 5, 1962.

angles.name: Shaken Not Stirred
angles.copy: It's Global James Bond Day! From iconic gadgets to unforgettable theme songs, what's your favourite Bond moment or tune? Shaken, not stirred, of course.

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: The legendary co-founder of The Beatles, John Lennon, would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message of peace continue to inspire millions around the world.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic English actor, comedian, screenwriter, and Monty Python star, John Cleese, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! A true comedy legend who has given us countless laughs from Monty Python to Fawlty Towers.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as the 'White Album', on November 22, 1968, in the UK.

angles.name: White Album Legacy
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles released the iconic 'White Album'. A sprawling, diverse masterpiece that showed every side of the Fab Four. What's your hidden gem from the album?

events.title: Anniversary of Freddie Mercury's passing
events.blurb: Legendary Queen frontman Freddie Mercury passed away on November 24, 1991.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day in 1991. His incredible voice and stage presence remain unmatched.
